method: Existing scripts/provenance.py Graph static Cargo manifest resolver; target cfg is explicit from generic target JSON or Linux host. No compiler executed. Graph build-only traversal is conservative and does not resolve build feature precision. Cloud cargo tree must independently confirm actual selected features before build.

archive_manifests.name: wasi
archive_manifests.declared_license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

disposition: Source import closure for review; actual Cargo feature tree is a cloud pre-compile condition, not yet confirmed.
scope: The selected TLS delta is partitioned from existing native crates and off-target lock-only packages. Existing provenance.py Graph uses explicit target cfg from generic target JSON / Linux, with conservative build dependency traversal. Expanded local features follow each crate manifest; this does not claim Cargo resolver equivalence.
metadata_confirmation: Two source-inspection-only Cargo tree attempts ended: custom target needed unstable-options; corrected query refused offline on missing off-target defmt source. No code generation, compilation, tests or target output. Root directs actual locked offline Cargo trees for both targets first on admitted cloud before compilation.
existing_lock_policy: Root, SSH, integration and std locks are byte-identical to base. This fixture is an isolated workspace and a listed=false workload-images unit; it is excluded from operator_image.py:NATIVE. Existing REUSE ** annotation covers new first-party files.
source_material_policy: Pinned archives verified before source inspection; patched ring exact source manifest checks file set and content before reuse. Only generated public DER under fixtures/native-tls/pki/*.der is allowed, separately sealed before build. Private PKI is outside the worktree/evidence.

cargo_feature_comparison.scope: Exact Cargo feature expectations for each tls_selected package; all selected package identities must also match the target partition before compilation.
cargo_feature_comparison.static_graph_field: expanded_local_features preserves the original conservative provenance Graph output, including requested default markers even where the manifest has no named default feature.
cargo_feature_comparison.expected_field: expected_tls_cargo_features lists actual Cargo named features expected from the pinned manifests. It removes only the nonexistent default markers for cfg-if, getrandom and untrusted, and adds manifest-precise build-only feature expectations for cc, find-msvc-tools and shlex.
cargo_feature_comparison.requirement: The cloud Cargo tree query must match expected_tls_cargo_features exactly on both targets before compilation. An unexpected declared feature or package remains a refusal.
